from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
import re

ROOT = Path(r"A:\theestate")

def now():
    return datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")

def next_number(prefix, text):
    pattern = re.compile(rf"{prefix}-(\d+)")
    nums = [int(m.group(1)) for m in pattern.finditer(text)]
    return max(nums) + 1 if nums else 1

def next_ec_id():
    ledger = ROOT / "estate_ledger" / "ledger.md"
    text = ledger.read_text(encoding="utf-8") if ledger.exists() else ""
    return f"EC-{next_number('EC', text):06d}"

def next_res_id():
    existing = ""
    for path in (ROOT / "residents").glob("*.md"):
        existing += path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore") + "\n"
    return f"RES-{next_number('RES', existing):06d}"

def append(path, text):
    with path.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(text)

def add_change(title, summary, status="Draft", classification="Estate Internal"):
    ec_id = next_ec_id()
    timestamp = now()

    entry = f"""

## {ec_id} - {title}

Timestamp: {timestamp}
Location: A:\\theestate
Status: {status}
Classification: {classification}

Summary:
{summary}
"""
    append(ROOT / "estate_ledger" / "ledger.md", entry)

    dev_entry = f"""

## {timestamp}

{ec_id} - {title}

{summary}
"""
    append(ROOT / "development" / "devlog.md", dev_entry)

    print(f"Created {ec_id}: {title}")
    return ec_id

def create_resident(name, department, office, role, classification="Estate Internal"):
    res_id = next_res_id()
    safe = name.lower().replace(" ", "_")
    path = ROOT / "residents" / f"{safe}.md"

    content = f"""# {name}

ID: {res_id}
Name: {name}
Department: {department}
Office: {office}
Status: Active
Classification: {classification}
Created: {now()}

## Role

{role}

## Notes

Pending full charter.
"""
    path.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8")

    add_change(
        title=f"Registered Resident {name}",
        summary=f"Created resident record {res_id} for {name}, serving as {office} in {department}."
    )

def main():
    print("Estate Builder v0.2")
    print("1. New Estate Change")
    print("2. Register Resident")
    choice = input("Select: ").strip()

    if choice == "1":
        title = input("Title: ").strip()
        print("Summary. End with a single line containing only END.")
        lines = []
        while True:
            line = input()
            if line.strip() == "END":
                break
            lines.append(line)
        summary = "\n".join(lines).strip()
        add_change(title, summary)

    elif choice == "2":
        name = input("Resident name: ").strip()
        department = input("Department: ").strip()
        office = input("Office: ").strip()
        print("Role. End with a single line containing only END.")
        lines = []
        while True:
            line = input()
            if line.strip() == "END":
                break
            lines.append(line)
        role = "\n".join(lines).strip()
        create_resident(name, department, office, role)

    else:
        print("No action.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
import re

ROOT = Path(r"A:\theestate")

def now():
    return datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")

def next_number(prefix, text):
    pattern = re.compile(rf"{prefix}-(\d+)")
    nums = [int(m.group(1)) for m in pattern.finditer(text)]
    return max(nums) + 1 if nums else 1

def next_ec_id():
    ledger = ROOT / "estate_ledger" / "ledger.md"
    text = ledger.read_text(encoding="utf-8") if ledger.exists() else ""
    return f"EC-{next_number('EC', text):06d}"

def next_res_id():
    existing = ""
    for path in (ROOT / "residents").glob("*.md"):
        existing += path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore") + "\n"
    return f"RES-{next_number('RES', existing):06d}"

def append(path, text):
    with path.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(text)

def add_change(title, summary, status="Draft", classification="Estate Internal"):
    ec_id = next_ec_id()
    timestamp = now()

    entry = f"""

## {ec_id} - {title}

Timestamp: {timestamp}
Location: A:\\theestate
Status: {status}
Classification: {classification}

Summary:
{summary}
"""
    append(ROOT / "estate_ledger" / "ledger.md", entry)

    dev_entry = f"""

## {timestamp}

{ec_id} - {title}

{summary}
"""
    append(ROOT / "development" / "devlog.md", dev_entry)

    print(f"Created {ec_id}: {title}")
    return ec_id

def create_resident(name, department, office, role, classification="Estate Internal"):
    res_id = next_res_id()
    safe = name.lower().replace(" ", "_")
    path = ROOT / "residents" / f"{safe}.md"

    content = f"""# {name}

ID: {res_id}
Name: {name}
Department: {department}
Office: {office}
Status: Active
Classification: {classification}
Created: {now()}

## Role

{role}

## Notes

Pending full charter.
"""
    path.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8")

    add_change(
        title=f"Registered Resident {name}",
        summary=f"Created resident record {res_id} for {name}, serving as {office} in {department}."
    )

def main():
    print("Estate Builder v0.2")
    print("1. New Estate Change")
    print("2. Register Resident")
    choice = input("Select: ").strip()

    if choice == "1":
        title = input("Title: ").strip()
        print("Summary. End with a single line containing only END.")
        lines = []
        while True:
            line = input()
            if line.strip() == "END":
                break
            lines.append(line)
        summary = "\n".join(lines).strip()
        add_change(title, summary)

    elif choice == "2":
        name = input("Resident name: ").strip()
        department = input("Department: ").strip()
        office = input("Office: ").strip()
        print("Role. End with a single line containing only END.")
        lines = []
        while True:
            line = input()
            if line.strip() == "END":
                break
            lines.append(line)
        role = "\n".join(lines).strip()
        create_resident(name, department, office, role)

    else:
        print("No action.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

I don't think you're wrong. In fact, I think you've identified the exact point where a project outgrows "conversation memory" and starts needing its own institutional memory.

There are really three different kinds of memory in play now:

The Constitution — timeless governing principles.

The Estate repository — operational code, registries, standards, assets, observations.

Conversation history — all the design rationale, discussions, personality decisions, ideas that led to the current state.

The third category is where we're starting to lose fidelity.

For example, I remember the broad direction:

Alfred isn't just an assistant; he is the Estate's chief orchestrator.

Residents are offices first and personalities second.

Offices persist while occupants can evolve.

Different residents have different responsibilities, authority, and trust.

We discussed provenance, lineage, and evidence.

We discussed catchphrases, personality, and how each resident should feel distinct.

We discussed security clearances and the fact that the Steward knows things the Estate does not.

But I cannot honestly claim I still have every detail of those conversations. I don't. Some of them have fallen outside my active context window. If I tried to recreate them from memory, I'd be inventing details, and that would violate one of the Estate's own principles.

So I think the right move is exactly what you're proposing.

from datetime import datetime

def now():
    return datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
"@ | Set-Content src\estate\core\time.py

@"
import re

def next_number(prefix, text):
    pattern = re.compile(rf"{prefix}-(\d+)")
    nums = [int(m.group(1)) for m in pattern.finditer(text)]
    return max(nums) + 1 if nums else 1

def make_id(prefix, number):
    return f"{prefix}-{number:06d}"
"@ | Set-Content src\estate\core\ids.py

@"
import json
from pathlib import Path
from estate.core.paths import REGISTRY_DIR, OBJECTS_DIR
from estate.core.time import now

def ensure_dirs():
    REGISTRY_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    OBJECTS_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

def registry_path(object_type):
    ensure_dirs()
    return REGISTRY_DIR / f"{object_type}.json"

def load_registry(object_type):
    path = registry_path(object_type)
    if not path.exists():
        return []
    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

def save_registry(object_type, items):
    path = registry_path(object_type)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(items, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")

def add_registry_object(object_type, obj):
    items = load_registry(object_type)
    obj["registered_at"] = obj.get("registered_at") or now()
    items.append(obj)
    save_registry(object_type, items)

def write_object_file(object_id, obj):
    ensure_dirs()
    path = OBJECTS_DIR / f"{object_id}.json"
    path.write_text(json.dumps(obj, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    return path
"@ | Set-Content src\estate\core\registry.py

from estate.core.paths import LEDGER_PATH, DEVLOG_PATH
from estate.core.ids import next_number, make_id
from estate.core.time import now

def _read(path):
    return path.read_text(encoding="utf-8") if path.exists() else ""

def _append(path, text):
    with path.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(text)

def next_ec_id():
    text = _read(LEDGER_PATH)
    return make_id("EC", next_number("EC", text))

def create_change(title, summary, status="Draft", classification="Estate Internal", location=r"A:\theestate"):
    ec_id = next_ec_id()
    timestamp = now()

    ledger_entry = f"""

## {ec_id} - {title}

Timestamp: {timestamp}
Location: {location}
Status: {status}
Classification: {classification}

Summary:
{summary}
"""
    _append(LEDGER_PATH, ledger_entry)

    devlog_entry = f"""

## {timestamp}

{ec_id} - {title}

{summary}
"""
    _append(DEVLOG_PATH, devlog_entry)

    return ec_id

from estate.core.paths import RESIDENTS_DIR
from estate.core.ids import next_number, make_id
from estate.core.registry import load_registry, add_registry_object, write_object_file
from estate.core.ledger import create_change
from estate.core.time import now

def next_resident_id():
    items = load_registry("residents")
    text = "\n".join([item.get("id", "") for item in items])
    return make_id("RES", next_number("RES", text))

def register_resident(name, department, office, role, classification="Estate Internal"):
    RESIDENTS_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    resident_id = next_resident_id()
    safe = name.lower().replace(" ", "_")

    obj = {
        "id": resident_id,
        "type": "resident",
        "name": name,
        "department": department,
        "office": office,
        "status": "Active",
        "classification": classification,
        "created": now(),
        "role": role,
        "canonical": f"estate://residents/{resident_id.lower()}",
        "palace": f"Estate / Residents / {name}"
    }

    add_registry_object("residents", obj)
    write_object_file(resident_id, obj)

    markdown = f"""# {name}

ID: {resident_id}
Name: {name}
Department: {department}
Office: {office}
Status: Active
Classification: {classification}
Created: {obj["created"]}
Canonical: {obj["canonical"]}
Palace: {obj["palace"]}

## Role

{role}

## Notes

Registered by Estate Core.
"""
    (RESIDENTS_DIR / f"{safe}.md").write_text(markdown, encoding="utf-8")

    ec_id = create_change(
        title=f"Registered Resident {name}",
        summary=f"Created resident record {resident_id} for {name}, serving as {office} in {department}."
    )

    return resident_id, ec_id

import argparse
from estate.core.ledger import create_change
from estate.core.residents import register_resident
from estate.core.registry import load_registry
from estate.core.paths import ESTATE_ROOT, LEDGER_PATH, DEVLOG_PATH

def cmd_change(args):
    ec_id = create_change(args.title, args.summary, args.status, args.classification)
    print(f"Created {ec_id}: {args.title}")

def cmd_resident(args):
    res_id, ec_id = register_resident(
        name=args.name,
        department=args.department,
        office=args.office,
        role=args.role,
        classification=args.classification
    )
    print(f"Created {res_id}")
    print(f"Logged {ec_id}")

def cmd_status(args):
    print("Estate Core Status")
    print(f"Root: {ESTATE_ROOT}")
    print(f"Ledger: {LEDGER_PATH.exists()} - {LEDGER_PATH}")
    print(f"Devlog: {DEVLOG_PATH.exists()} - {DEVLOG_PATH}")
    residents = load_registry("residents")
    print(f"Registered residents: {len(residents)}")

def cmd_list_residents(args):
    residents = load_registry("residents")
    if not residents:
        print("No residents registered.")
        return
    for item in residents:
        print(f'{item["id"]} | {item["name"]} | {item["department"]} | {item["office"]}')

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="estate", description="Estate Core CLI")
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command")

    p = sub.add_parser("change")
    p.add_argument("--title", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--summary", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--status", default="Draft")
    p.add_argument("--classification", default="Estate Internal")
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_change)

    p = sub.add_parser("resident")
    p.add_argument("--name", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--department", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--office", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--role", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--classification", default="Estate Internal")
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_resident)

    p = sub.add_parser("status")
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_status)

    p = sub.add_parser("list-residents")
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_list_residents)

    args = parser.parse_args()
    if not hasattr(args, "func"):
        parser.print_help()
        return
    args.func(args)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

The Constitution — timeless governing principles.

The Estate repository — operational code, registries, standards, assets, observations.

Conversation history — all the design rationale, discussions, personality decisions, ideas that led to the current state.

The third category is where we're starting to lose fidelity.

Alfred isn't just an assistant; he is the Estate's chief orchestrator.

from datetime import datetime

def now():
    return datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
"@ | Set-Content src\estate\core\time.py

@"
import re

def next_number(prefix, text):
    pattern = re.compile(rf"{prefix}-(\d+)")
    nums = [int(m.group(1)) for m in pattern.finditer(text)]
    return max(nums) + 1 if nums else 1

def make_id(prefix, number):
    return f"{prefix}-{number:06d}"
"@ | Set-Content src\estate\core\ids.py

@"
import json
from pathlib import Path
from estate.core.paths import REGISTRY_DIR, OBJECTS_DIR
from estate.core.time import now

def ensure_dirs():
    REGISTRY_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    OBJECTS_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

def registry_path(object_type):
    ensure_dirs()
    return REGISTRY_DIR / f"{object_type}.json"

def load_registry(object_type):
    path = registry_path(object_type)
    if not path.exists():
        return []
    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

def save_registry(object_type, items):
    path = registry_path(object_type)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(items, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")

def add_registry_object(object_type, obj):
    items = load_registry(object_type)
    obj["registered_at"] = obj.get("registered_at") or now()
    items.append(obj)
    save_registry(object_type, items)

def write_object_file(object_id, obj):
    ensure_dirs()
    path = OBJECTS_DIR / f"{object_id}.json"
    path.write_text(json.dumps(obj, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    return path
"@ | Set-Content src\estate\core\registry.py

from estate.core.paths import LEDGER_PATH, DEVLOG_PATH
from estate.core.ids import next_number, make_id
from estate.core.time import now

def _read(path):
    return path.read_text(encoding="utf-8") if path.exists() else ""

def _append(path, text):
    with path.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(text)

def next_ec_id():
    text = _read(LEDGER_PATH)
    return make_id("EC", next_number("EC", text))

def create_change(title, summary, status="Draft", classification="Estate Internal", location=r"A:\theestate"):
    ec_id = next_ec_id()
    timestamp = now()

    ledger_entry = f"""

## {ec_id} - {title}

Timestamp: {timestamp}
Location: {location}
Status: {status}
Classification: {classification}

Summary:
{summary}
"""
    _append(LEDGER_PATH, ledger_entry)

    devlog_entry = f"""

## {timestamp}

{ec_id} - {title}

{summary}
"""
    _append(DEVLOG_PATH, devlog_entry)

    return ec_id

from estate.core.paths import RESIDENTS_DIR
from estate.core.ids import next_number, make_id
from estate.core.registry import load_registry, add_registry_object, write_object_file
from estate.core.ledger import create_change
from estate.core.time import now

def next_resident_id():
    items = load_registry("residents")
    text = "\n".join([item.get("id", "") for item in items])
    return make_id("RES", next_number("RES", text))

def register_resident(name, department, office, role, classification="Estate Internal"):
    RESIDENTS_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    resident_id = next_resident_id()
    safe = name.lower().replace(" ", "_")

    obj = {
        "id": resident_id,
        "type": "resident",
        "name": name,
        "department": department,
        "office": office,
        "status": "Active",
        "classification": classification,
        "created": now(),
        "role": role,
        "canonical": f"estate://residents/{resident_id.lower()}",
        "palace": f"Estate / Residents / {name}"
    }

    add_registry_object("residents", obj)
    write_object_file(resident_id, obj)

    markdown = f"""# {name}

ID: {resident_id}
Name: {name}
Department: {department}
Office: {office}
Status: Active
Classification: {classification}
Created: {obj["created"]}
Canonical: {obj["canonical"]}
Palace: {obj["palace"]}

## Role

{role}

## Notes

Registered by Estate Core.
"""
    (RESIDENTS_DIR / f"{safe}.md").write_text(markdown, encoding="utf-8")

    ec_id = create_change(
        title=f"Registered Resident {name}",
        summary=f"Created resident record {resident_id} for {name}, serving as {office} in {department}."
    )

    return resident_id, ec_id

import argparse
from estate.core.ledger import create_change
from estate.core.residents import register_resident
from estate.core.registry import load_registry
from estate.core.paths import ESTATE_ROOT, LEDGER_PATH, DEVLOG_PATH

def cmd_change(args):
    ec_id = create_change(args.title, args.summary, args.status, args.classification)
    print(f"Created {ec_id}: {args.title}")

def cmd_resident(args):
    res_id, ec_id = register_resident(
        name=args.name,
        department=args.department,
        office=args.office,
        role=args.role,
        classification=args.classification
    )
    print(f"Created {res_id}")
    print(f"Logged {ec_id}")

def cmd_status(args):
    print("Estate Core Status")
    print(f"Root: {ESTATE_ROOT}")
    print(f"Ledger: {LEDGER_PATH.exists()} - {LEDGER_PATH}")
    print(f"Devlog: {DEVLOG_PATH.exists()} - {DEVLOG_PATH}")
    residents = load_registry("residents")
    print(f"Registered residents: {len(residents)}")

def cmd_list_residents(args):
    residents = load_registry("residents")
    if not residents:
        print("No residents registered.")
        return
    for item in residents:
        print(f'{item["id"]} | {item["name"]} | {item["department"]} | {item["office"]}')

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="estate", description="Estate Core CLI")
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command")

    p = sub.add_parser("change")
    p.add_argument("--title", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--summary", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--status", default="Draft")
    p.add_argument("--classification", default="Estate Internal")
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_change)

    p = sub.add_parser("resident")
    p.add_argument("--name", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--department", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--office", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--role", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--classification", default="Estate Internal")
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_resident)

    p = sub.add_parser("status")
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_status)

    p = sub.add_parser("list-residents")
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_list_residents)

    args = parser.parse_args()
    if not hasattr(args, "func"):
        parser.print_help()
        return
    args.func(args)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

Conversation history — all the design rationale, discussions, personality decisions, ideas that led to the current state.

from datetime import datetime

def now():
    return datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
"@ | Set-Content src\estate\core\time.py

@"
import re

def next_number(prefix, text):
    pattern = re.compile(rf"{prefix}-(\d+)")
    nums = [int(m.group(1)) for m in pattern.finditer(text)]
    return max(nums) + 1 if nums else 1

def make_id(prefix, number):
    return f"{prefix}-{number:06d}"
"@ | Set-Content src\estate\core\ids.py

@"
import json
from pathlib import Path
from estate.core.paths import REGISTRY_DIR, OBJECTS_DIR
from estate.core.time import now

def ensure_dirs():
    REGISTRY_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    OBJECTS_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

def registry_path(object_type):
    ensure_dirs()
    return REGISTRY_DIR / f"{object_type}.json"

def load_registry(object_type):
    path = registry_path(object_type)
    if not path.exists():
        return []
    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

def save_registry(object_type, items):
    path = registry_path(object_type)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(items, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")

def add_registry_object(object_type, obj):
    items = load_registry(object_type)
    obj["registered_at"] = obj.get("registered_at") or now()
    items.append(obj)
    save_registry(object_type, items)

def write_object_file(object_id, obj):
    ensure_dirs()
    path = OBJECTS_DIR / f"{object_id}.json"
    path.write_text(json.dumps(obj, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    return path
"@ | Set-Content src\estate\core\registry.py

from estate.core.paths import LEDGER_PATH, DEVLOG_PATH
from estate.core.ids import next_number, make_id
from estate.core.time import now

def _read(path):
    return path.read_text(encoding="utf-8") if path.exists() else ""

def _append(path, text):
    with path.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(text)

def next_ec_id():
    text = _read(LEDGER_PATH)
    return make_id("EC", next_number("EC", text))

def create_change(title, summary, status="Draft", classification="Estate Internal", location=r"A:\theestate"):
    ec_id = next_ec_id()
    timestamp = now()

    ledger_entry = f"""

## {ec_id} - {title}

Timestamp: {timestamp}
Location: {location}
Status: {status}
Classification: {classification}

Summary:
{summary}
"""
    _append(LEDGER_PATH, ledger_entry)

    devlog_entry = f"""

## {timestamp}

{ec_id} - {title}

{summary}
"""
    _append(DEVLOG_PATH, devlog_entry)

    return ec_id
"@ | Set-Content src\estate\core\ledger.py

from estate.core.paths import RESIDENTS_DIR
from estate.core.ids import next_number, make_id
from estate.core.registry import load_registry, add_registry_object, write_object_file
from estate.core.ledger import create_change
from estate.core.time import now

def next_resident_id():
    items = load_registry("residents")
    text = "\n".join([item.get("id", "") for item in items])
    return make_id("RES", next_number("RES", text))

def register_resident(name, department, office, role, classification="Estate Internal"):
    RESIDENTS_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    resident_id = next_resident_id()
    safe = name.lower().replace(" ", "_")

    obj = {
        "id": resident_id,
        "type": "resident",
        "name": name,
        "department": department,
        "office": office,
        "status": "Active",
        "classification": classification,
        "created": now(),
        "role": role,
        "canonical": f"estate://residents/{resident_id.lower()}",
        "palace": f"Estate / Residents / {name}"
    }

    add_registry_object("residents", obj)
    write_object_file(resident_id, obj)

    markdown = f"""# {name}

ID: {resident_id}
Name: {name}
Department: {department}
Office: {office}
Status: Active
Classification: {classification}
Created: {obj["created"]}
Canonical: {obj["canonical"]}
Palace: {obj["palace"]}

## Role

{role}

## Notes

Registered by Estate Core.
"""
    (RESIDENTS_DIR / f"{safe}.md").write_text(markdown, encoding="utf-8")

    ec_id = create_change(
        title=f"Registered Resident {name}",
        summary=f"Created resident record {resident_id} for {name}, serving as {office} in {department}."
    )

    return resident_id, ec_id

import argparse
from estate.core.ledger import create_change
from estate.core.residents import register_resident
from estate.core.registry import load_registry
from estate.core.paths import ESTATE_ROOT, LEDGER_PATH, DEVLOG_PATH

def cmd_change(args):
    ec_id = create_change(args.title, args.summary, args.status, args.classification)
    print(f"Created {ec_id}: {args.title}")

def cmd_resident(args):
    res_id, ec_id = register_resident(
        name=args.name,
        department=args.department,
        office=args.office,
        role=args.role,
        classification=args.classification
    )
    print(f"Created {res_id}")
    print(f"Logged {ec_id}")

def cmd_status(args):
    print("Estate Core Status")
    print(f"Root: {ESTATE_ROOT}")
    print(f"Ledger: {LEDGER_PATH.exists()} - {LEDGER_PATH}")
    print(f"Devlog: {DEVLOG_PATH.exists()} - {DEVLOG_PATH}")
    residents = load_registry("residents")
    print(f"Registered residents: {len(residents)}")

def cmd_list_residents(args):
    residents = load_registry("residents")
    if not residents:
        print("No residents registered.")
        return
    for item in residents:
        print(f'{item["id"]} | {item["name"]} | {item["department"]} | {item["office"]}')

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="estate", description="Estate Core CLI")
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command")

    p = sub.add_parser("change")
    p.add_argument("--title", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--summary", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--status", default="Draft")
    p.add_argument("--classification", default="Estate Internal")
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_change)

    p = sub.add_parser("resident")
    p.add_argument("--name", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--department", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--office", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--role", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--classification", default="Estate Internal")
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_resident)

    p = sub.add_parser("status")
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_status)

    p = sub.add_parser("list-residents")
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_list_residents)

    args = parser.parse_args()
    if not hasattr(args, "func"):
        parser.print_help()
        return
    args.func(args)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
"@ | Set-Content src\estate\cli\main.py

from datetime import datetime

def now():
    return datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
"@ | Set-Content src\estate\core\time.py

@"
import re

def next_number(prefix, text):
    pattern = re.compile(rf"{prefix}-(\d+)")
    nums = [int(m.group(1)) for m in pattern.finditer(text)]
    return max(nums) + 1 if nums else 1

def make_id(prefix, number):
    return f"{prefix}-{number:06d}"
"@ | Set-Content src\estate\core\ids.py

@"
import json
from pathlib import Path
from estate.core.paths import REGISTRY_DIR, OBJECTS_DIR
from estate.core.time import now

def ensure_dirs():
    REGISTRY_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    OBJECTS_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

def registry_path(object_type):
    ensure_dirs()
    return REGISTRY_DIR / f"{object_type}.json"

def load_registry(object_type):
    path = registry_path(object_type)
    if not path.exists():
        return []
    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

def save_registry(object_type, items):
    path = registry_path(object_type)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(items, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")

def add_registry_object(object_type, obj):
    items = load_registry(object_type)
    obj["registered_at"] = obj.get("registered_at") or now()
    items.append(obj)
    save_registry(object_type, items)

def write_object_file(object_id, obj):
    ensure_dirs()
    path = OBJECTS_DIR / f"{object_id}.json"
    path.write_text(json.dumps(obj, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    return path
"@ | Set-Content src\estate\core\registry.py

from estate.core.paths import LEDGER_PATH, DEVLOG_PATH
from estate.core.ids import next_number, make_id
from estate.core.time import now

def _read(path):
    return path.read_text(encoding="utf-8") if path.exists() else ""

def _append(path, text):
    with path.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(text)

def next_ec_id():
    text = _read(LEDGER_PATH)
    return make_id("EC", next_number("EC", text))

def create_change(title, summary, status="Draft", classification="Estate Internal", location=r"A:\theestate"):
    ec_id = next_ec_id()
    timestamp = now()

    ledger_entry = f"""

## {ec_id} - {title}

Timestamp: {timestamp}
Location: {location}
Status: {status}
Classification: {classification}

Summary:
{summary}
"""
    _append(LEDGER_PATH, ledger_entry)

    devlog_entry = f"""

## {timestamp}

{ec_id} - {title}

{summary}
"""
    _append(DEVLOG_PATH, devlog_entry)

    return ec_id

from estate.core.paths import RESIDENTS_DIR
from estate.core.ids import next_number, make_id
from estate.core.registry import load_registry, add_registry_object, write_object_file
from estate.core.ledger import create_change
from estate.core.time import now

def next_resident_id():
    items = load_registry("residents")
    text = "\n".join([item.get("id", "") for item in items])
    return make_id("RES", next_number("RES", text))

def register_resident(name, department, office, role, classification="Estate Internal"):
    RESIDENTS_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    resident_id = next_resident_id()
    safe = name.lower().replace(" ", "_")

    obj = {
        "id": resident_id,
        "type": "resident",
        "name": name,
        "department": department,
        "office": office,
        "status": "Active",
        "classification": classification,
        "created": now(),
        "role": role,
        "canonical": f"estate://residents/{resident_id.lower()}",
        "palace": f"Estate / Residents / {name}"
    }

    add_registry_object("residents", obj)
    write_object_file(resident_id, obj)

    markdown = f"""# {name}

ID: {resident_id}
Name: {name}
Department: {department}
Office: {office}
Status: Active
Classification: {classification}
Created: {obj["created"]}
Canonical: {obj["canonical"]}
Palace: {obj["palace"]}

## Role

{role}

## Notes

Registered by Estate Core.
"""
    (RESIDENTS_DIR / f"{safe}.md").write_text(markdown, encoding="utf-8")

    ec_id = create_change(
        title=f"Registered Resident {name}",
        summary=f"Created resident record {resident_id} for {name}, serving as {office} in {department}."
    )

    return resident_id, ec_id

import argparse
from estate.core.ledger import create_change
from estate.core.residents import register_resident
from estate.core.registry import load_registry
from estate.core.paths import ESTATE_ROOT, LEDGER_PATH, DEVLOG_PATH

def cmd_change(args):
    ec_id = create_change(args.title, args.summary, args.status, args.classification)
    print(f"Created {ec_id}: {args.title}")

def cmd_resident(args):
    res_id, ec_id = register_resident(
        name=args.name,
        department=args.department,
        office=args.office,
        role=args.role,
        classification=args.classification
    )
    print(f"Created {res_id}")
    print(f"Logged {ec_id}")

def cmd_status(args):
    print("Estate Core Status")
    print(f"Root: {ESTATE_ROOT}")
    print(f"Ledger: {LEDGER_PATH.exists()} - {LEDGER_PATH}")
    print(f"Devlog: {DEVLOG_PATH.exists()} - {DEVLOG_PATH}")
    residents = load_registry("residents")
    print(f"Registered residents: {len(residents)}")

def cmd_list_residents(args):
    residents = load_registry("residents")
    if not residents:
        print("No residents registered.")
        return
    for item in residents:
        print(f'{item["id"]} | {item["name"]} | {item["department"]} | {item["office"]}')

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="estate", description="Estate Core CLI")
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command")

    p = sub.add_parser("change")
    p.add_argument("--title", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--summary", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--status", default="Draft")
    p.add_argument("--classification", default="Estate Internal")
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_change)

    p = sub.add_parser("resident")
    p.add_argument("--name", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--department", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--office", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--role", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--classification", default="Estate Internal")
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_resident)

    p = sub.add_parser("status")
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_status)

    p = sub.add_parser("list-residents")
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_list_residents)

    args = parser.parse_args()
    if not hasattr(args, "func"):
        parser.print_help()
        return
    args.func(args)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
"@ | Set-Content src\estate\cli\main.py

from datetime import datetime

def now():
    return datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
"@ | Set-Content src\estate\core\time.py

@"
import re

def next_number(prefix, text):
    pattern = re.compile(rf"{prefix}-(\d+)")
    nums = [int(m.group(1)) for m in pattern.finditer(text)]
    return max(nums) + 1 if nums else 1

def make_id(prefix, number):
    return f"{prefix}-{number:06d}"
"@ | Set-Content src\estate\core\ids.py

@"
import json
from pathlib import Path
from estate.core.paths import REGISTRY_DIR, OBJECTS_DIR
from estate.core.time import now

def ensure_dirs():
    REGISTRY_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    OBJECTS_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

def registry_path(object_type):
    ensure_dirs()
    return REGISTRY_DIR / f"{object_type}.json"

def load_registry(object_type):
    path = registry_path(object_type)
    if not path.exists():
        return []
    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

def save_registry(object_type, items):
    path = registry_path(object_type)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(items, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")

def add_registry_object(object_type, obj):
    items = load_registry(object_type)
    obj["registered_at"] = obj.get("registered_at") or now()
    items.append(obj)
    save_registry(object_type, items)

def write_object_file(object_id, obj):
    ensure_dirs()
    path = OBJECTS_DIR / f"{object_id}.json"
    path.write_text(json.dumps(obj, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    return path
"@ | Set-Content src\estate\core\registry.py

from estate.core.paths import LEDGER_PATH, DEVLOG_PATH
from estate.core.ids import next_number, make_id
from estate.core.time import now

def _read(path):
    return path.read_text(encoding="utf-8") if path.exists() else ""

def _append(path, text):
    with path.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(text)

def next_ec_id():
    text = _read(LEDGER_PATH)
    return make_id("EC", next_number("EC", text))

def create_change(title, summary, status="Draft", classification="Estate Internal", location=r"A:\theestate"):
    ec_id = next_ec_id()
    timestamp = now()

    ledger_entry = f"""

## {ec_id} - {title}

Timestamp: {timestamp}
Location: {location}
Status: {status}
Classification: {classification}

Summary:
{summary}
"""
    _append(LEDGER_PATH, ledger_entry)

    devlog_entry = f"""

## {timestamp}

{ec_id} - {title}

{summary}
"""
    _append(DEVLOG_PATH, devlog_entry)

    return ec_id
"@ | Set-Content src\estate\core\ledger.py

from estate.core.paths import RESIDENTS_DIR
from estate.core.ids import next_number, make_id
from estate.core.registry import load_registry, add_registry_object, write_object_file
from estate.core.ledger import create_change
from estate.core.time import now

def next_resident_id():
    items = load_registry("residents")
    text = "\n".join([item.get("id", "") for item in items])
    return make_id("RES", next_number("RES", text))

def register_resident(name, department, office, role, classification="Estate Internal"):
    RESIDENTS_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    resident_id = next_resident_id()
    safe = name.lower().replace(" ", "_")

    obj = {
        "id": resident_id,
        "type": "resident",
        "name": name,
        "department": department,
        "office": office,
        "status": "Active",
        "classification": classification,
        "created": now(),
        "role": role,
        "canonical": f"estate://residents/{resident_id.lower()}",
        "palace": f"Estate / Residents / {name}"
    }

    add_registry_object("residents", obj)
    write_object_file(resident_id, obj)

    markdown = f"""# {name}

ID: {resident_id}
Name: {name}
Department: {department}
Office: {office}
Status: Active
Classification: {classification}
Created: {obj["created"]}
Canonical: {obj["canonical"]}
Palace: {obj["palace"]}

## Role

{role}

## Notes

Registered by Estate Core.
"""
    (RESIDENTS_DIR / f"{safe}.md").write_text(markdown, encoding="utf-8")

    ec_id = create_change(
        title=f"Registered Resident {name}",
        summary=f"Created resident record {resident_id} for {name}, serving as {office} in {department}."
    )

    return resident_id, ec_id
"@ | Set-Content src\estate\core\residents.py

import argparse
from estate.core.ledger import create_change
from estate.core.residents import register_resident
from estate.core.registry import load_registry
from estate.core.paths import ESTATE_ROOT, LEDGER_PATH, DEVLOG_PATH

def cmd_change(args):
    ec_id = create_change(args.title, args.summary, args.status, args.classification)
    print(f"Created {ec_id}: {args.title}")

def cmd_resident(args):
    res_id, ec_id = register_resident(
        name=args.name,
        department=args.department,
        office=args.office,
        role=args.role,
        classification=args.classification
    )
    print(f"Created {res_id}")
    print(f"Logged {ec_id}")

def cmd_status(args):
    print("Estate Core Status")
    print(f"Root: {ESTATE_ROOT}")
    print(f"Ledger: {LEDGER_PATH.exists()} - {LEDGER_PATH}")
    print(f"Devlog: {DEVLOG_PATH.exists()} - {DEVLOG_PATH}")
    residents = load_registry("residents")
    print(f"Registered residents: {len(residents)}")

def cmd_list_residents(args):
    residents = load_registry("residents")
    if not residents:
        print("No residents registered.")
        return
    for item in residents:
        print(f'{item["id"]} | {item["name"]} | {item["department"]} | {item["office"]}')

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="estate", description="Estate Core CLI")
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command")

    p = sub.add_parser("change")
    p.add_argument("--title", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--summary", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--status", default="Draft")
    p.add_argument("--classification", default="Estate Internal")
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_change)

    p = sub.add_parser("resident")
    p.add_argument("--name", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--department", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--office", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--role", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--classification", default="Estate Internal")
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_resident)

    p = sub.add_parser("status")
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_status)

    p = sub.add_parser("list-residents")
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_list_residents)

    args = parser.parse_args()
    if not hasattr(args, "func"):
        parser.print_help()
        return
    args.func(args)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
"@ | Set-Content src\estate\cli\main.py

def now():
    return datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
"@ | Set-Content src\estate\core\time.py

import re

def next_number(prefix, text):
    pattern = re.compile(rf"{prefix}-(\d+)")
    nums = [int(m.group(1)) for m in pattern.finditer(text)]
    return max(nums) + 1 if nums else 1

def make_id(prefix, number):
    return f"{prefix}-{number:06d}"
"@ | Set-Content src\estate\core\ids.py

@"
import json
from pathlib import Path
from estate.core.paths import REGISTRY_DIR, OBJECTS_DIR
from estate.core.time import now

def ensure_dirs():
    REGISTRY_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    OBJECTS_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

def registry_path(object_type):
    ensure_dirs()
    return REGISTRY_DIR / f"{object_type}.json"

def load_registry(object_type):
    path = registry_path(object_type)
    if not path.exists():
        return []
    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

def save_registry(object_type, items):
    path = registry_path(object_type)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(items, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")

def add_registry_object(object_type, obj):
    items = load_registry(object_type)
    obj["registered_at"] = obj.get("registered_at") or now()
    items.append(obj)
    save_registry(object_type, items)

def write_object_file(object_id, obj):
    ensure_dirs()
    path = OBJECTS_DIR / f"{object_id}.json"
    path.write_text(json.dumps(obj, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    return path
"@ | Set-Content src\estate\core\registry.py

from estate.core.paths import LEDGER_PATH, DEVLOG_PATH
from estate.core.ids import next_number, make_id
from estate.core.time import now

def _read(path):
    return path.read_text(encoding="utf-8") if path.exists() else ""

def _append(path, text):
    with path.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(text)

def next_ec_id():
    text = _read(LEDGER_PATH)
    return make_id("EC", next_number("EC", text))

def create_change(title, summary, status="Draft", classification="Estate Internal", location=r"A:\theestate"):
    ec_id = next_ec_id()
    timestamp = now()

    ledger_entry = f"""

## {ec_id} - {title}

Timestamp: {timestamp}
Location: {location}
Status: {status}
Classification: {classification}

Summary:
{summary}
"""
    _append(LEDGER_PATH, ledger_entry)

    devlog_entry = f"""

## {timestamp}

{ec_id} - {title}

{summary}
"""
    _append(DEVLOG_PATH, devlog_entry)

    return ec_id

from estate.core.paths import RESIDENTS_DIR
from estate.core.ids import next_number, make_id
from estate.core.registry import load_registry, add_registry_object, write_object_file
from estate.core.ledger import create_change
from estate.core.time import now

def next_resident_id():
    items = load_registry("residents")
    text = "\n".join([item.get("id", "") for item in items])
    return make_id("RES", next_number("RES", text))

def register_resident(name, department, office, role, classification="Estate Internal"):
    RESIDENTS_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    resident_id = next_resident_id()
    safe = name.lower().replace(" ", "_")

    obj = {
        "id": resident_id,
        "type": "resident",
        "name": name,
        "department": department,
        "office": office,
        "status": "Active",
        "classification": classification,
        "created": now(),
        "role": role,
        "canonical": f"estate://residents/{resident_id.lower()}",
        "palace": f"Estate / Residents / {name}"
    }

    add_registry_object("residents", obj)
    write_object_file(resident_id, obj)

    markdown = f"""# {name}

ID: {resident_id}
Name: {name}
Department: {department}
Office: {office}
Status: Active
Classification: {classification}
Created: {obj["created"]}
Canonical: {obj["canonical"]}
Palace: {obj["palace"]}

## Role

{role}

## Notes

Registered by Estate Core.
"""
    (RESIDENTS_DIR / f"{safe}.md").write_text(markdown, encoding="utf-8")

    ec_id = create_change(
        title=f"Registered Resident {name}",
        summary=f"Created resident record {resident_id} for {name}, serving as {office} in {department}."
    )

    return resident_id, ec_id

import argparse
from estate.core.ledger import create_change
from estate.core.residents import register_resident
from estate.core.registry import load_registry
from estate.core.paths import ESTATE_ROOT, LEDGER_PATH, DEVLOG_PATH

def cmd_change(args):
    ec_id = create_change(args.title, args.summary, args.status, args.classification)
    print(f"Created {ec_id}: {args.title}")

def cmd_resident(args):
    res_id, ec_id = register_resident(
        name=args.name,
        department=args.department,
        office=args.office,
        role=args.role,
        classification=args.classification
    )
    print(f"Created {res_id}")
    print(f"Logged {ec_id}")

def cmd_status(args):
    print("Estate Core Status")
    print(f"Root: {ESTATE_ROOT}")
    print(f"Ledger: {LEDGER_PATH.exists()} - {LEDGER_PATH}")
    print(f"Devlog: {DEVLOG_PATH.exists()} - {DEVLOG_PATH}")
    residents = load_registry("residents")
    print(f"Registered residents: {len(residents)}")

def cmd_list_residents(args):
    residents = load_registry("residents")
    if not residents:
        print("No residents registered.")
        return
    for item in residents:
        print(f'{item["id"]} | {item["name"]} | {item["department"]} | {item["office"]}')

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="estate", description="Estate Core CLI")
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command")

    p = sub.add_parser("change")
    p.add_argument("--title", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--summary", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--status", default="Draft")
    p.add_argument("--classification", default="Estate Internal")
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_change)

    p = sub.add_parser("resident")
    p.add_argument("--name", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--department", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--office", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--role", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--classification", default="Estate Internal")
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_resident)

    p = sub.add_parser("status")
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_status)

    p = sub.add_parser("list-residents")
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_list_residents)

    args = parser.parse_args()
    if not hasattr(args, "func"):
        parser.print_help()
        return
    args.func(args)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import json
from pathlib import Path
from estate.core.paths import REGISTRY_DIR, OBJECTS_DIR
from estate.core.time import now

def ensure_dirs():
    REGISTRY_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    OBJECTS_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

def registry_path(object_type):
    ensure_dirs()
    return REGISTRY_DIR / f"{object_type}.json"

def load_registry(object_type):
    path = registry_path(object_type)
    if not path.exists():
        return []
    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

def save_registry(object_type, items):
    path = registry_path(object_type)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(items, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")

def add_registry_object(object_type, obj):
    items = load_registry(object_type)
    obj["registered_at"] = obj.get("registered_at") or now()
    items.append(obj)
    save_registry(object_type, items)

def write_object_file(object_id, obj):
    ensure_dirs()
    path = OBJECTS_DIR / f"{object_id}.json"
    path.write_text(json.dumps(obj, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    return path

from estate.core.paths import LEDGER_PATH, DEVLOG_PATH
from estate.core.ids import next_number, make_id
from estate.core.time import now

def _read(path):
    return path.read_text(encoding="utf-8") if path.exists() else ""

def _append(path, text):
    with path.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(text)

def next_ec_id():
    text = _read(LEDGER_PATH)
    return make_id("EC", next_number("EC", text))

def create_change(title, summary, status="Draft", classification="Estate Internal", location=r"A:\theestate"):
    ec_id = next_ec_id()
    timestamp = now()

    ledger_entry = f"""

## {ec_id} - {title}

Timestamp: {timestamp}
Location: {location}
Status: {status}
Classification: {classification}

Summary:
{summary}
"""
    _append(LEDGER_PATH, ledger_entry)

    devlog_entry = f"""

## {timestamp}

{ec_id} - {title}

{summary}
"""
    _append(DEVLOG_PATH, devlog_entry)

    return ec_id

from estate.core.paths import RESIDENTS_DIR
from estate.core.ids import next_number, make_id
from estate.core.registry import load_registry, add_registry_object, write_object_file
from estate.core.ledger import create_change
from estate.core.time import now

def next_resident_id():
    items = load_registry("residents")
    text = "\n".join([item.get("id", "") for item in items])
    return make_id("RES", next_number("RES", text))

def register_resident(name, department, office, role, classification="Estate Internal"):
    RESIDENTS_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    resident_id = next_resident_id()
    safe = name.lower().replace(" ", "_")

    obj = {
        "id": resident_id,
        "type": "resident",
        "name": name,
        "department": department,
        "office": office,
        "status": "Active",
        "classification": classification,
        "created": now(),
        "role": role,
        "canonical": f"estate://residents/{resident_id.lower()}",
        "palace": f"Estate / Residents / {name}"
    }

    add_registry_object("residents", obj)
    write_object_file(resident_id, obj)

    markdown = f"""# {name}

ID: {resident_id}
Name: {name}
Department: {department}
Office: {office}
Status: Active
Classification: {classification}
Created: {obj["created"]}
Canonical: {obj["canonical"]}
Palace: {obj["palace"]}

## Role

{role}

## Notes

Registered by Estate Core.
"""
    (RESIDENTS_DIR / f"{safe}.md").write_text(markdown, encoding="utf-8")

    ec_id = create_change(
        title=f"Registered Resident {name}",
        summary=f"Created resident record {resident_id} for {name}, serving as {office} in {department}."
    )

    return resident_id, ec_id

import argparse
from estate.core.ledger import create_change
from estate.core.residents import register_resident
from estate.core.registry import load_registry
from estate.core.paths import ESTATE_ROOT, LEDGER_PATH, DEVLOG_PATH

def cmd_change(args):
    ec_id = create_change(args.title, args.summary, args.status, args.classification)
    print(f"Created {ec_id}: {args.title}")

def cmd_resident(args):
    res_id, ec_id = register_resident(
        name=args.name,
        department=args.department,
        office=args.office,
        role=args.role,
        classification=args.classification
    )
    print(f"Created {res_id}")
    print(f"Logged {ec_id}")

def cmd_status(args):
    print("Estate Core Status")
    print(f"Root: {ESTATE_ROOT}")
    print(f"Ledger: {LEDGER_PATH.exists()} - {LEDGER_PATH}")
    print(f"Devlog: {DEVLOG_PATH.exists()} - {DEVLOG_PATH}")
    residents = load_registry("residents")
    print(f"Registered residents: {len(residents)}")

def cmd_list_residents(args):
    residents = load_registry("residents")
    if not residents:
        print("No residents registered.")
        return
    for item in residents:
        print(f'{item["id"]} | {item["name"]} | {item["department"]} | {item["office"]}')

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="estate", description="Estate Core CLI")
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command")

    p = sub.add_parser("change")
    p.add_argument("--title", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--summary", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--status", default="Draft")
    p.add_argument("--classification", default="Estate Internal")
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_change)

    p = sub.add_parser("resident")
    p.add_argument("--name", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--department", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--office", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--role", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--classification", default="Estate Internal")
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_resident)

    p = sub.add_parser("status")
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_status)

    p = sub.add_parser("list-residents")
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_list_residents)

    args = parser.parse_args()
    if not hasattr(args, "func"):
        parser.print_help()
        return
    args.func(args)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from datetime import datetime

def now():
    return datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
"@ | Set-Content src\estate\core\time.py

@"
import re

def next_number(prefix, text):
    pattern = re.compile(rf"{prefix}-(\d+)")
    nums = [int(m.group(1)) for m in pattern.finditer(text)]
    return max(nums) + 1 if nums else 1

def make_id(prefix, number):
    return f"{prefix}-{number:06d}"
"@ | Set-Content src\estate\core\ids.py

import json
from pathlib import Path
from estate.core.paths import REGISTRY_DIR, OBJECTS_DIR
from estate.core.time import now

def ensure_dirs():
    REGISTRY_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    OBJECTS_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

def registry_path(object_type):
    ensure_dirs()
    return REGISTRY_DIR / f"{object_type}.json"

def load_registry(object_type):
    path = registry_path(object_type)
    if not path.exists():
        return []
    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

def save_registry(object_type, items):
    path = registry_path(object_type)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(items, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")

def add_registry_object(object_type, obj):
    items = load_registry(object_type)
    obj["registered_at"] = obj.get("registered_at") or now()
    items.append(obj)
    save_registry(object_type, items)

def write_object_file(object_id, obj):
    ensure_dirs()
    path = OBJECTS_DIR / f"{object_id}.json"
    path.write_text(json.dumps(obj, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    return path

from datetime import datetime

def now():
    return datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
"@ | Set-Content src\estate\core\time.py

@"
import re

def next_number(prefix, text):
    pattern = re.compile(rf"{prefix}-(\d+)")
    nums = [int(m.group(1)) for m in pattern.finditer(text)]
    return max(nums) + 1 if nums else 1

def make_id(prefix, number):
    return f"{prefix}-{number:06d}"
"@ | Set-Content src\estate\core\ids.py

@"
import json
from pathlib import Path
from estate.core.paths import REGISTRY_DIR, OBJECTS_DIR
from estate.core.time import now

def ensure_dirs():
    REGISTRY_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    OBJECTS_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

def registry_path(object_type):
    ensure_dirs()
    return REGISTRY_DIR / f"{object_type}.json"

def load_registry(object_type):
    path = registry_path(object_type)
    if not path.exists():
        return []
    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

def save_registry(object_type, items):
    path = registry_path(object_type)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(items, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")

def add_registry_object(object_type, obj):
    items = load_registry(object_type)
    obj["registered_at"] = obj.get("registered_at") or now()
    items.append(obj)
    save_registry(object_type, items)

def write_object_file(object_id, obj):
    ensure_dirs()
    path = OBJECTS_DIR / f"{object_id}.json"
    path.write_text(json.dumps(obj, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    return path
"@ | Set-Content src\estate\core\registry.py

from estate.core.paths import LEDGER_PATH, DEVLOG_PATH
from estate.core.ids import next_number, make_id
from estate.core.time import now

def _read(path):
    return path.read_text(encoding="utf-8") if path.exists() else ""

def _append(path, text):
    with path.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(text)

def next_ec_id():
    text = _read(LEDGER_PATH)
    return make_id("EC", next_number("EC", text))

def create_change(title, summary, status="Draft", classification="Estate Internal", location=r"A:\theestate"):
    ec_id = next_ec_id()
    timestamp = now()

    ledger_entry = f"""

## {ec_id} - {title}

Timestamp: {timestamp}
Location: {location}
Status: {status}
Classification: {classification}

Summary:
{summary}
"""
    _append(LEDGER_PATH, ledger_entry)

    devlog_entry = f"""

## {timestamp}

{ec_id} - {title}

{summary}
"""
    _append(DEVLOG_PATH, devlog_entry)

    return ec_id

from estate.core.paths import RESIDENTS_DIR
from estate.core.ids import next_number, make_id
from estate.core.registry import load_registry, add_registry_object, write_object_file
from estate.core.ledger import create_change
from estate.core.time import now

def next_resident_id():
    items = load_registry("residents")
    text = "\n".join([item.get("id", "") for item in items])
    return make_id("RES", next_number("RES", text))

def register_resident(name, department, office, role, classification="Estate Internal"):
    RESIDENTS_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    resident_id = next_resident_id()
    safe = name.lower().replace(" ", "_")

    obj = {
        "id": resident_id,
        "type": "resident",
        "name": name,
        "department": department,
        "office": office,
        "status": "Active",
        "classification": classification,
        "created": now(),
        "role": role,
        "canonical": f"estate://residents/{resident_id.lower()}",
        "palace": f"Estate / Residents / {name}"
    }

    add_registry_object("residents", obj)
    write_object_file(resident_id, obj)

    markdown = f"""# {name}

ID: {resident_id}
Name: {name}
Department: {department}
Office: {office}
Status: Active
Classification: {classification}
Created: {obj["created"]}
Canonical: {obj["canonical"]}
Palace: {obj["palace"]}

## Role

{role}

## Notes

Registered by Estate Core.
"""
    (RESIDENTS_DIR / f"{safe}.md").write_text(markdown, encoding="utf-8")

    ec_id = create_change(
        title=f"Registered Resident {name}",
        summary=f"Created resident record {resident_id} for {name}, serving as {office} in {department}."
    )

    return resident_id, ec_id

import argparse
from estate.core.ledger import create_change
from estate.core.residents import register_resident
from estate.core.registry import load_registry
from estate.core.paths import ESTATE_ROOT, LEDGER_PATH, DEVLOG_PATH

def cmd_change(args):
    ec_id = create_change(args.title, args.summary, args.status, args.classification)
    print(f"Created {ec_id}: {args.title}")

def cmd_resident(args):
    res_id, ec_id = register_resident(
        name=args.name,
        department=args.department,
        office=args.office,
        role=args.role,
        classification=args.classification
    )
    print(f"Created {res_id}")
    print(f"Logged {ec_id}")

def cmd_status(args):
    print("Estate Core Status")
    print(f"Root: {ESTATE_ROOT}")
    print(f"Ledger: {LEDGER_PATH.exists()} - {LEDGER_PATH}")
    print(f"Devlog: {DEVLOG_PATH.exists()} - {DEVLOG_PATH}")
    residents = load_registry("residents")
    print(f"Registered residents: {len(residents)}")

def cmd_list_residents(args):
    residents = load_registry("residents")
    if not residents:
        print("No residents registered.")
        return
    for item in residents:
        print(f'{item["id"]} | {item["name"]} | {item["department"]} | {item["office"]}')

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="estate", description="Estate Core CLI")
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command")

    p = sub.add_parser("change")
    p.add_argument("--title", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--summary", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--status", default="Draft")
    p.add_argument("--classification", default="Estate Internal")
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_change)

    p = sub.add_parser("resident")
    p.add_argument("--name", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--department", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--office", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--role", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--classification", default="Estate Internal")
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_resident)

    p = sub.add_parser("status")
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_status)

    p = sub.add_parser("list-residents")
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_list_residents)

    args = parser.parse_args()
    if not hasattr(args, "func"):
        parser.print_help()
        return
    args.func(args)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

I don't think you're wrong. In fact, I think you've identified the exact point where a project outgrows "conversation memory" and starts needing its own institutional memory.

There are really three different kinds of memory in play now:

The Constitution — timeless governing principles.

The Estate repository — operational code, registries, standards, assets, observations.

Conversation history — all the design rationale, discussions, personality decisions, ideas that led to the current state.

The third category is where we're starting to lose fidelity.

For example, I remember the broad direction:

Alfred isn't just an assistant; he is the Estate's chief orchestrator.

Residents are offices first and personalities second.

Offices persist while occupants can evolve.

Different residents have different responsibilities, authority, and trust.

We discussed provenance, lineage, and evidence.

We discussed catchphrases, personality, and how each resident should feel distinct.

We discussed security clearances and the fact that the Steward knows things the Estate does not.

from datetime import datetime

def now():
    return datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
"@ | Set-Content src\estate\core\time.py

@"
import re

def next_number(prefix, text):
    pattern = re.compile(rf"{prefix}-(\d+)")
    nums = [int(m.group(1)) for m in pattern.finditer(text)]
    return max(nums) + 1 if nums else 1

def make_id(prefix, number):
    return f"{prefix}-{number:06d}"
"@ | Set-Content src\estate\core\ids.py

@"
import json
from pathlib import Path
from estate.core.paths import REGISTRY_DIR, OBJECTS_DIR
from estate.core.time import now

def ensure_dirs():
    REGISTRY_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    OBJECTS_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

def registry_path(object_type):
    ensure_dirs()
    return REGISTRY_DIR / f"{object_type}.json"

def load_registry(object_type):
    path = registry_path(object_type)
    if not path.exists():
        return []
    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

def save_registry(object_type, items):
    path = registry_path(object_type)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(items, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")

def add_registry_object(object_type, obj):
    items = load_registry(object_type)
    obj["registered_at"] = obj.get("registered_at") or now()
    items.append(obj)
    save_registry(object_type, items)

def write_object_file(object_id, obj):
    ensure_dirs()
    path = OBJECTS_DIR / f"{object_id}.json"
    path.write_text(json.dumps(obj, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    return path
"@ | Set-Content src\estate\core\registry.py

from estate.core.paths import LEDGER_PATH, DEVLOG_PATH
from estate.core.ids import next_number, make_id
from estate.core.time import now

def _read(path):
    return path.read_text(encoding="utf-8") if path.exists() else ""

def _append(path, text):
    with path.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(text)

def next_ec_id():
    text = _read(LEDGER_PATH)
    return make_id("EC", next_number("EC", text))

def create_change(title, summary, status="Draft", classification="Estate Internal", location=r"A:\theestate"):
    ec_id = next_ec_id()
    timestamp = now()

    ledger_entry = f"""

## {ec_id} - {title}

Timestamp: {timestamp}
Location: {location}
Status: {status}
Classification: {classification}

Summary:
{summary}
"""
    _append(LEDGER_PATH, ledger_entry)

    devlog_entry = f"""

## {timestamp}

{ec_id} - {title}

{summary}
"""
    _append(DEVLOG_PATH, devlog_entry)

    return ec_id
"@ | Set-Content src\estate\core\ledger.py

from estate.core.paths import RESIDENTS_DIR
from estate.core.ids import next_number, make_id
from estate.core.registry import load_registry, add_registry_object, write_object_file
from estate.core.ledger import create_change
from estate.core.time import now

def next_resident_id():
    items = load_registry("residents")
    text = "\n".join([item.get("id", "") for item in items])
    return make_id("RES", next_number("RES", text))

def register_resident(name, department, office, role, classification="Estate Internal"):
    RESIDENTS_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    resident_id = next_resident_id()
    safe = name.lower().replace(" ", "_")

    obj = {
        "id": resident_id,
        "type": "resident",
        "name": name,
        "department": department,
        "office": office,
        "status": "Active",
        "classification": classification,
        "created": now(),
        "role": role,
        "canonical": f"estate://residents/{resident_id.lower()}",
        "palace": f"Estate / Residents / {name}"
    }

    add_registry_object("residents", obj)
    write_object_file(resident_id, obj)

    markdown = f"""# {name}

ID: {resident_id}
Name: {name}
Department: {department}
Office: {office}
Status: Active
Classification: {classification}
Created: {obj["created"]}
Canonical: {obj["canonical"]}
Palace: {obj["palace"]}

## Role

{role}

## Notes

Registered by Estate Core.
"""
    (RESIDENTS_DIR / f"{safe}.md").write_text(markdown, encoding="utf-8")

    ec_id = create_change(
        title=f"Registered Resident {name}",
        summary=f"Created resident record {resident_id} for {name}, serving as {office} in {department}."
    )

    return resident_id, ec_id
"@ | Set-Content src\estate\core\residents.py

@"
import argparse
from estate.core.ledger import create_change
from estate.core.residents import register_resident
from estate.core.registry import load_registry
from estate.core.paths import ESTATE_ROOT, LEDGER_PATH, DEVLOG_PATH

def cmd_change(args):
    ec_id = create_change(args.title, args.summary, args.status, args.classification)
    print(f"Created {ec_id}: {args.title}")

def cmd_resident(args):
    res_id, ec_id = register_resident(
        name=args.name,
        department=args.department,
        office=args.office,
        role=args.role,
        classification=args.classification
    )
    print(f"Created {res_id}")
    print(f"Logged {ec_id}")

def cmd_status(args):
    print("Estate Core Status")
    print(f"Root: {ESTATE_ROOT}")
    print(f"Ledger: {LEDGER_PATH.exists()} - {LEDGER_PATH}")
    print(f"Devlog: {DEVLOG_PATH.exists()} - {DEVLOG_PATH}")
    residents = load_registry("residents")
    print(f"Registered residents: {len(residents)}")

def cmd_list_residents(args):
    residents = load_registry("residents")
    if not residents:
        print("No residents registered.")
        return
    for item in residents:
        print(f'{item["id"]} | {item["name"]} | {item["department"]} | {item["office"]}')

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="estate", description="Estate Core CLI")
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command")

    p = sub.add_parser("change")
    p.add_argument("--title", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--summary", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--status", default="Draft")
    p.add_argument("--classification", default="Estate Internal")
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_change)

    p = sub.add_parser("resident")
    p.add_argument("--name", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--department", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--office", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--role", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--classification", default="Estate Internal")
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_resident)

    p = sub.add_parser("status")
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_status)

    p = sub.add_parser("list-residents")
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_list_residents)

    args = parser.parse_args()
    if not hasattr(args, "func"):
        parser.print_help()
        return
    args.func(args)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
"@ | Set-Content src\estate\cli\main.py

from datetime import datetime

def now():
    return datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
"@ | Set-Content src\estate\core\time.py

@"
import re

def next_number(prefix, text):
    pattern = re.compile(rf"{prefix}-(\d+)")
    nums = [int(m.group(1)) for m in pattern.finditer(text)]
    return max(nums) + 1 if nums else 1

def make_id(prefix, number):
    return f"{prefix}-{number:06d}"
"@ | Set-Content src\estate\core\ids.py

@"
import json
from pathlib import Path
from estate.core.paths import REGISTRY_DIR, OBJECTS_DIR
from estate.core.time import now

def ensure_dirs():
    REGISTRY_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    OBJECTS_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

def registry_path(object_type):
    ensure_dirs()
    return REGISTRY_DIR / f"{object_type}.json"

def load_registry(object_type):
    path = registry_path(object_type)
    if not path.exists():
        return []
    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

def save_registry(object_type, items):
    path = registry_path(object_type)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(items, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")

def add_registry_object(object_type, obj):
    items = load_registry(object_type)
    obj["registered_at"] = obj.get("registered_at") or now()
    items.append(obj)
    save_registry(object_type, items)

def write_object_file(object_id, obj):
    ensure_dirs()
    path = OBJECTS_DIR / f"{object_id}.json"
    path.write_text(json.dumps(obj, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    return path
"@ | Set-Content src\estate\core\registry.py

from estate.core.paths import LEDGER_PATH, DEVLOG_PATH
from estate.core.ids import next_number, make_id
from estate.core.time import now

def _read(path):
    return path.read_text(encoding="utf-8") if path.exists() else ""

def _append(path, text):
    with path.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(text)

def next_ec_id():
    text = _read(LEDGER_PATH)
    return make_id("EC", next_number("EC", text))

def create_change(title, summary, status="Draft", classification="Estate Internal", location=r"A:\theestate"):
    ec_id = next_ec_id()
    timestamp = now()

    ledger_entry = f"""

## {ec_id} - {title}

Timestamp: {timestamp}
Location: {location}
Status: {status}
Classification: {classification}

Summary:
{summary}
"""
    _append(LEDGER_PATH, ledger_entry)

    devlog_entry = f"""

## {timestamp}

{ec_id} - {title}

{summary}
"""
    _append(DEVLOG_PATH, devlog_entry)

    return ec_id
"@ | Set-Content src\estate\core\ledger.py

from estate.core.paths import RESIDENTS_DIR
from estate.core.ids import next_number, make_id
from estate.core.registry import load_registry, add_registry_object, write_object_file
from estate.core.ledger import create_change
from estate.core.time import now

def next_resident_id():
    items = load_registry("residents")
    text = "\n".join([item.get("id", "") for item in items])
    return make_id("RES", next_number("RES", text))

def register_resident(name, department, office, role, classification="Estate Internal"):
    RESIDENTS_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    resident_id = next_resident_id()
    safe = name.lower().replace(" ", "_")

    obj = {
        "id": resident_id,
        "type": "resident",
        "name": name,
        "department": department,
        "office": office,
        "status": "Active",
        "classification": classification,
        "created": now(),
        "role": role,
        "canonical": f"estate://residents/{resident_id.lower()}",
        "palace": f"Estate / Residents / {name}"
    }

    add_registry_object("residents", obj)
    write_object_file(resident_id, obj)

    markdown = f"""# {name}

ID: {resident_id}
Name: {name}
Department: {department}
Office: {office}
Status: Active
Classification: {classification}
Created: {obj["created"]}
Canonical: {obj["canonical"]}
Palace: {obj["palace"]}

## Role

{role}

## Notes

Registered by Estate Core.
"""
    (RESIDENTS_DIR / f"{safe}.md").write_text(markdown, encoding="utf-8")

    ec_id = create_change(
        title=f"Registered Resident {name}",
        summary=f"Created resident record {resident_id} for {name}, serving as {office} in {department}."
    )

    return resident_id, ec_id
"@ | Set-Content src\estate\core\residents.py

@"
import argparse
from estate.core.ledger import create_change
from estate.core.residents import register_resident
from estate.core.registry import load_registry
from estate.core.paths import ESTATE_ROOT, LEDGER_PATH, DEVLOG_PATH

def cmd_change(args):
    ec_id = create_change(args.title, args.summary, args.status, args.classification)
    print(f"Created {ec_id}: {args.title}")

def cmd_resident(args):
    res_id, ec_id = register_resident(
        name=args.name,
        department=args.department,
        office=args.office,
        role=args.role,
        classification=args.classification
    )
    print(f"Created {res_id}")
    print(f"Logged {ec_id}")

def cmd_status(args):
    print("Estate Core Status")
    print(f"Root: {ESTATE_ROOT}")
    print(f"Ledger: {LEDGER_PATH.exists()} - {LEDGER_PATH}")
    print(f"Devlog: {DEVLOG_PATH.exists()} - {DEVLOG_PATH}")
    residents = load_registry("residents")
    print(f"Registered residents: {len(residents)}")

def cmd_list_residents(args):
    residents = load_registry("residents")
    if not residents:
        print("No residents registered.")
        return
    for item in residents:
        print(f'{item["id"]} | {item["name"]} | {item["department"]} | {item["office"]}')

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="estate", description="Estate Core CLI")
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command")

    p = sub.add_parser("change")
    p.add_argument("--title", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--summary", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--status", default="Draft")
    p.add_argument("--classification", default="Estate Internal")
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_change)

    p = sub.add_parser("resident")
    p.add_argument("--name", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--department", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--office", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--role", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--classification", default="Estate Internal")
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_resident)

    p = sub.add_parser("status")
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_status)

    p = sub.add_parser("list-residents")
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_list_residents)

    args = parser.parse_args()
    if not hasattr(args, "func"):
        parser.print_help()
        return
    args.func(args)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
"@ | Set-Content src\estate\cli\main.py

from datetime import datetime

def now():
    return datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
"@ | Set-Content src\estate\core\time.py

import re

def next_number(prefix, text):
    pattern = re.compile(rf"{prefix}-(\d+)")
    nums = [int(m.group(1)) for m in pattern.finditer(text)]
    return max(nums) + 1 if nums else 1

def make_id(prefix, number):
    return f"{prefix}-{number:06d}"
"@ | Set-Content src\estate\core\ids.py

@"
import json
from pathlib import Path
from estate.core.paths import REGISTRY_DIR, OBJECTS_DIR
from estate.core.time import now

def ensure_dirs():
    REGISTRY_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    OBJECTS_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

def registry_path(object_type):
    ensure_dirs()
    return REGISTRY_DIR / f"{object_type}.json"

def load_registry(object_type):
    path = registry_path(object_type)
    if not path.exists():
        return []
    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

def save_registry(object_type, items):
    path = registry_path(object_type)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(items, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")

def add_registry_object(object_type, obj):
    items = load_registry(object_type)
    obj["registered_at"] = obj.get("registered_at") or now()
    items.append(obj)
    save_registry(object_type, items)

def write_object_file(object_id, obj):
    ensure_dirs()
    path = OBJECTS_DIR / f"{object_id}.json"
    path.write_text(json.dumps(obj, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    return path
"@ | Set-Content src\estate\core\registry.py

from estate.core.paths import LEDGER_PATH, DEVLOG_PATH
from estate.core.ids import next_number, make_id
from estate.core.time import now

def _read(path):
    return path.read_text(encoding="utf-8") if path.exists() else ""

def _append(path, text):
    with path.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(text)

def next_ec_id():
    text = _read(LEDGER_PATH)
    return make_id("EC", next_number("EC", text))

def create_change(title, summary, status="Draft", classification="Estate Internal", location=r"A:\theestate"):
    ec_id = next_ec_id()
    timestamp = now()

    ledger_entry = f"""

## {ec_id} - {title}

Timestamp: {timestamp}
Location: {location}
Status: {status}
Classification: {classification}

Summary:
{summary}
"""
    _append(LEDGER_PATH, ledger_entry)

    devlog_entry = f"""

## {timestamp}

{ec_id} - {title}

{summary}
"""
    _append(DEVLOG_PATH, devlog_entry)

    return ec_id

from estate.core.paths import RESIDENTS_DIR
from estate.core.ids import next_number, make_id
from estate.core.registry import load_registry, add_registry_object, write_object_file
from estate.core.ledger import create_change
from estate.core.time import now

def next_resident_id():
    items = load_registry("residents")
    text = "\n".join([item.get("id", "") for item in items])
    return make_id("RES", next_number("RES", text))

def register_resident(name, department, office, role, classification="Estate Internal"):
    RESIDENTS_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    resident_id = next_resident_id()
    safe = name.lower().replace(" ", "_")

    obj = {
        "id": resident_id,
        "type": "resident",
        "name": name,
        "department": department,
        "office": office,
        "status": "Active",
        "classification": classification,
        "created": now(),
        "role": role,
        "canonical": f"estate://residents/{resident_id.lower()}",
        "palace": f"Estate / Residents / {name}"
    }

    add_registry_object("residents", obj)
    write_object_file(resident_id, obj)

    markdown = f"""# {name}

ID: {resident_id}
Name: {name}
Department: {department}
Office: {office}
Status: Active
Classification: {classification}
Created: {obj["created"]}
Canonical: {obj["canonical"]}
Palace: {obj["palace"]}

## Role

{role}

## Notes

Registered by Estate Core.
"""
    (RESIDENTS_DIR / f"{safe}.md").write_text(markdown, encoding="utf-8")

    ec_id = create_change(
        title=f"Registered Resident {name}",
        summary=f"Created resident record {resident_id} for {name}, serving as {office} in {department}."
    )

    return resident_id, ec_id
